title: Father's teacher unknown
summary: She cannot recall who her father studied with, only his first solo at 18 and that he was a very good musician.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: By the way, do you know where he had his lessons or if he, who he studied with, the name of a teacher or if he went to a certain school or anything? That I can't remember. Did he ever tell you anything about that?

I can't remember. All I can remember, my mother telling me about him being 18 years old. When he had his first solo. When he played his first solo at the Globe's Hall. I can remember that. But, I don't remember who he studied under. But he did study under someone. He had to, to know music like he knew it. He really, he was really a good musician. He can tell you that.
